name: credit-usage
description: A real-time dashboard for the credits your Kiro Crew agents consume. It reads the per-turn usage log the gateway already writes and rolls it up live: total credits with today / this-week / this-month figures, a daily consumption trend, a breakdown by model, surface (dashboard, cron, subagent, webhook) and agent, the sessions that spent the most, and a rolling feed of the most recent turns as they land. Read-only by design — it only reads the local usage log, and shows no token counts you didn't already generate.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Live credit total with today / this-week / this-month rollups, polled every few seconds
Daily consumption trend so you can see spend accelerate or settle
Breakdown by model, by surface (dashboard / cron / subagent / webhook) and by agent
Top-spending sessions ranked, with per-session credits and turn counts
Rolling feed of the most recent turns as they complete
Read-only: reads the local per-turn usage log only, never writes or bills anything
